findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

On arrival there was not a CFPM available at the facility. The CFPM arrived approximately 45 minutes to an hour after the inspection began to correct the violation. Ensure that a CFPM is available at the facility at all times that foods and food contact surfaces are being handled.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

1) The hand sink in the front of the kitchen would not dispense soap. The equipment appeared to have run out of battery. The batteries were replaced and the equipment began to function correctly. Violation corrected. 2) The hand sink in the back of the kitchen appeared to have run out of soap in the dispenser. The soup was replaced with a new container and began dispensing correctly during the inspection. Both locations were shown to the PIC and education conducted. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied with soap at al times in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The hand sink in the front of the kitchen was observed without paper towels at the beginning of the inspection. The PIC was consulted and supplied new paper towels to correct the violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used.
findings.comment:
3-501.13(A-E) Thawing. TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be thawed: via an approved method. 

Two packages of beef were observed in one of the sinks thawing in standing water. The situation was discussed with the PIC and the water turned on to correct. Ensure that thawing takes place in the facility in a method approved by the code moving forward.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

Mozzarella cheese was observed stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Several other boxes of assorted foods were observed stored on the floor in the walk in freezer. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to store all foods off of the ground (at least 6 inches) prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all foods are stored off of the floor at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

An employee was observed to don gloves without hand washing and then proceeded to handle ready-to-eat foods. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to review with employees when hand washing is required. Ensure that hand washing takes place at all times that it is needed in the facility.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

On arrival the facility had test strips effective for testing quat sanitizer but are using a CL based sanitizer (bleach). The difference was discussed with the PIC and a small amount of CL test strips were acquired during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that test strips in the facility are intended for use with the sanitizer used in the facility at all times.
